people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
translations.bsb: Tyre has built herself a fortress; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
translations.kjv: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
translations.asv: And Tyre did build herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
